summary: Mobile-first single-user personal sports event manager (Push Sports Event Manager) with dashboard, calendar, event CRUD, reminders/notifications, payments tracking, offline secure storage, and voice input for quick event creation.
architectural_notes: Single-user (personal/internal use) app; no multi-user access required.
Offline-capable local data storage with autosave; store data securely on-device.
Pending Amount is auto-calculated (Total Event Amount - Advance Paid).
Notifications required: 1 day before event, event morning, and pending-payment reminders.
Voice input uses speech-to-text and intent/field extraction to populate Add Event form.
Mobile-first design with dark sports theme and bottom navigation (Home/Calendar/Add/Payments).
Consider optional Google Sheets connection for migrating/importing historical events and (if required) ongoing read/write sync with a specified spreadsheet.
Event model/UI should support multi-select sports per event (store as list).
Event scheduling should support a start and end datetime (from–to range) instead of a single date/time.
known_issues: Voice input populates Add Event, but the Event Details page does not show the updated values (likely refresh/state sync issue).

existing_features.title: Create a mobile-first dark sports themed UI system and app layout, including a persistent bottom navigation bar with tabs: Home, Calendar, Add Event, Payments.

Build the Dashboard (Home screen) to display: Total Events This Month, Upcoming Events (Next 7 Days), Total Revenue This Month, Total Pending Payments, and quick actions (+ Add New Event, Calendar View).

Implement the Add New Event form with all specified fields, validation, and auto-calculation of Pending Amount (Total Event Amount - Advance Paid). Include autosave/draft behavior to prevent losing data on navigation/refresh.
Implement Event Details screen that displays all event information including payment summary and requirements checklist, and provides actions: Edit, Delete, Mark as Completed.

Create a Monthly Calendar view that supports selecting a date to view that day’s events list, and selecting an event to open its details. Add visual highlighting rules: upcoming events in green, today’s events in blue, and events with overdue payments marked with a red indicator.
Implement a Payments screen that lists all events with pendingAmount > 0, displays total pending amount, and supports filtering by month.
Add an offline-capable storage strategy: cache events locally for fast load and offline access, and sync changes to the Motoko backend when connectivity is available (single-user).
Implement an in-browser reminder system that triggers local notifications (where supported) for: 1 day before an event, the morning of the event, and payment reminders when pendingAmount > 0.

Add a voice input feature on the Add Event screen: provide a microphone button that uses browser speech-to-text to capture a spoken booking sentence and auto-fill matching form fields (event name/type/date/time, organizer, amounts, requirements flags, location when stated).
Add a simple single-user access approach suitable for personal internal use (no multi-user sharing).
Generate and include basic static visual assets for the app (icon and a subtle sports-themed background/empty state) and render them from frontend static assets.

Add a Google Sheets import flow that lets the user copy all previous events from an existing Google Sheet into the app by providing a Google Sheets "Publish to web" CSV URL (or pasted CSV content), mapping rows into the app’s existing Event model, and creating the imported events in the Motoko backend.

Support updating existing app events from the same Google Sheet on subsequent sync runs by matching rows using a stable external identifier column (configured during import) and applying updates to existing events in the Motoko backend.

Fix the issue where events created/edited using Voice Input do not reflect the latest values when viewing the Event Details page (ensure the Event Details view always displays the just-saved event data without requiring a manual refresh).
Remove the Event Location section/field from the Event Details page UI (do not display location in the details view even if it exists in stored data).
Support selecting multiple sports for a single event in the Add Event and Edit Event forms, and display multiple selected sports on the Event Details page.

Change event date input from a single date to a date range (from–to) for Add Event and Edit Event, and show the range on Event Details. Use English labels for the range fields (e.g., "From" and "To").

new_feature_requests.summary: Dashboard (Home) showing monthly totals, upcoming events, revenue, pending payments, and quick actions
Add New Event form with required fields, event type dropdown, requirements checkboxes, status, and auto-calculated pending amount
Monthly Calendar view with date-to-events list, event details navigation, and color/indicator highlights (upcoming/today/overdue payments)
Event Details page with full info, payment summary, requirements checklist, edit/delete, and mark completed actions
Reminder/notification system (1 day before, event morning, and payment reminders when pending amount > 0)
Voice input (speech-to-text) on Add Event page to parse spoken commands and auto-fill fields
Offline-capable secure local data storage with autosave for events
Payments screen listing events with pending > 0, total pending amount, and month filter
Mobile-first UI/UX with dark sports theme and bottom navigation (Home, Calendar, Add Event, Payments)

Implement single-user event data model and persistence in the Motoko backend, including create/read/update/delete operations for events and derived fields needed by the UI (pendingAmount, payment status, etc.).
Google Sheets integration to import/copy existing events from a linked sheet and keep updates in sync (read/write)

Extend the Motoko backend API to efficiently upsert (create/update) multiple events in one request for Google Sheet import/sync, while maintaining the existing access-control checks and event validation rules.
Fix: events created/filled via Voice Input should correctly reflect/refresh on the Event Details page
Update Event Details screen to hide/remove the Event Location field
Support selecting multiple sports for a single event (multi-select)
Change event date field to a date/time range (from–to) instead of a single date
